note:
Fourteen measured regions over eleven of twenty-one pages, all accounted for: twelve rows - seven figures and five tables - plus two excluded regions, no refusals and no unmeasured exhibit. The paper numbers seven figures and five tables and all twelve own a region, so there is no ghost grid here either. Two of the regions are not exhibits at all: Table 3 runs off the foot of p8 and finishes at the head of p9 under the same four verticals with no repeated header, and p14's region is the partitioned (N+1)x(N+1) adjacency matrix the text calls a 'new modified adjacency matrix', seven stacked slices under one vertical and one horizontal dashed partition line - a display equation counted by the geometry pass as seven tiny images in one box.

One ruling register, five times over, with one exception: Tables 2, 3, 4 and 5 are closed boxes with full-height verticals at every column boundary, and Table 1 is the paper's only booktabs grid - three rules, no vertical anywhere, a heavy midrule under a two-line header and a single data row. Table 2 is the widest object at 419.0 pt against a 418.3 pt measure and the only grid with a diagonal header cell; Table 5 is the only one with three header bands and merged cells. Every scored column in the paper is centred rather than decimal-aligned and Table 3's 'four columns' are three: the parenthesised Shapley and betweenness values ride on a second line inside each name cell.

Defects recorded, not corrected: Figure 4's caption and the p9 prose promise twenty movie stars who all cooperated with Jude Law, while the drawing prints twenty labels for eighteen discs, cuts 'Ethan Haw' mid-word at the bitmap edge, leaves 'Clive Owen' without a disc and never prints 'Jude Law' at all; Figure 2's nodes are numbered and the caption says the numbers are the authors, but no key is printed anywhere in the paper; Figure 3 reads a power-law claim off a linear frequency axis whose degree scale stops at 51 while the same section counts 511 nodes; Table 2's caption calls the diagonal elements the small-world Erdos network although Erdos is not one of the grid's three rows; Table 1's caption says 'results of networks' plural over a single data row; Table 3 splits without repeating its header; and Figure 7 is five dead-flat lines over twenty values of d, so the sensitivity study finds nothing to report. The typos stand as printed: 'Application in Edros Network', 'Edros Network', 'unweithed network', 'weithed netwok', 'betweeness', 'free-scale network' for scale-free, and the sentence 'The two preceding measures are calculated as follows' introducing two formulas and one table.
rules: rows counts every printed row including the header bands, and the count comes from the horizontal rules minus one rather than from the text layer's line order: Table 3's five rules on p8 and six on p9 are five and six rows, eleven in all once the continuation is folded in [table.rows]

a drawn boundary count is not a column count: Table 3's four verticals over a header that prints three labels are three columns, because the Shapley and betweenness values sit on a second line inside each name cell and not in columns of their own [table.cols]

a grid is vertical-rules when full-height verticals close every column, booktabs when it prints horizontal rules only: Table 1 is the paper's single booktabs grid on three rules with a heavy midrule, and the other four are closed [table.rule_style]
a table that turns a page is one row with continued true and its far-page fragment is excluded split-across-pages, so Table 3 is eleven rows over two regions and not two grids [table.continued]

a two-line header band is one header row: Table 1's L/CC with actual/random subscripts and Table 2's three-line header both take header_rows 1, while Table 5's three stacked bands take 3 [table.header_rows]
merged header cells are recorded as merged: Table 5's 'Rank' runs down three bands and 'Optimized Pagerank Model' spans two columns sideways [table.merged_cells]
a diagonal stroke in the top-left cell makes it a diagonal header cell rather than two labels, so Table 2 keeps 4 columns and 4 rows with diagonal_header true [table.diagonal_header]

centred parenthesised values are not decimal alignment: every scored column in this paper is centred and mixes precision from four to nine places, so decimal_aligned is false throughout [table.decimal_aligned]

a grid over 75 per cent of the local measure is full: the five grids here run 81.0, 81.7, 86.3, 91.6 and 100.2 per cent of the 418.3 pt measure and every one of them is full, with the percentage named in its note [table.width]

a note_sentence must be a printed sentence on the grid's own page or the next one, so the three grids whose only prose sits a page or three earlier - Tables 2, 4 and 5 - carry the empty string and the pointer goes into the item note [table.note_sentence]
captions for this paper print the number with a full stop and no gloss - 'Figure 1. Model Design Process' - so numbering is Figure N. and Table N. throughout [caption.numbering]
every caption here prints below its figure and above its table without exception, and Figure 1's sits on the summary sheet between the drawing and the 'Results' heading [caption.position]

a caption that names the wrong thing is recorded as printed: Figure 2's 'Numbers beside the nodes represent the corresponding author' names a key the paper never prints, and Table 2's diagonal claim names a network that is not a row of the grid [caption.verbatim]
an exhibit the prose never numbers by name is still a row with count 0 and first_page null: Figures 1 and 4 and Table 4 print their captions but are never pointed at [mention.count]
an exhibit cited more than once keeps its FIRST citing page: Table 5's first_page is 13 although its grid is on p16 and its four citations straddle six pages [mention.lead_pages]

the heading detector reads sixteen printed table rows as headings on p8, p9 and p10, so every section_path here is the printed label of the heading that governs the region and all of them are marked section_numbered false [place.section_numbered]

a display equation measured as a region is not an exhibit: p14's seven stacked slices under one vertical and one horizontal dashed rule are one partitioned matrix and are excluded not-an-exhibit [place.section_kind]
